parameters.query: SELECT overall_status, asset_count, photos, videos, job_snapshot, failed_snapshot, backlog_total, ml_status, storage_accessible, problems, observation, test_mode, timestamp AS previous_timestamp FROM immich_monitor_state ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;

={{ `INSERT INTO immich_monitor_state (timestamp, overall_status, asset_count, photos, videos, job_snapshot, failed_snapshot, backlog_total, ml_status, storage_accessible, problems, observation, test_mode) VALUES ('${$json.persist.timestamp}'::timestamptz, '${$json.persist.overall_status}', ${$json.persist.asset_count === null || $json.persist.asset_count === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.persist.asset_count}, ${$json.persist.photos === null || $json.persist.photos === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.persist.photos}, ${$json.persist.videos === null || $json.persist.videos === undefined ? 'NULL' : $json.persist.videos}, '${JSON.stringify($json.persist.job_snapshot || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb, '${JSON.stringify($json.persist.failed_snapshot || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb, ${Number($json.persist.backlog_total || 0)}, '${String($json.persist.ml_status || 'unknown').replace(/'/g, "''")}', ${$json.persist.storage_accessible === true ? 'true' : ($json.persist.storage_accessible === false ? 'false' : 'NULL')}, '${JSON.stringify($json.persist.problems || []).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb, '${JSON.stringify($json.persist.observation || {}).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb, ${$json.persist.test_mode ? 'true' : 'false'});` }}
